description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to manipulate and retrieve data related to leave entitlements, such as available days, date periods, and associated entities like Employee and LeaveType. It acts as a decorator to enhance or modify the behavior of the LeaveEntitlement entity.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides additional functionalities for the LeaveEntitlement entity such as calculating available days, checking if a date is within the entitlement period, and setting related entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific LeaveEntitlement object.

methods.name: getAvailableDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of available leave days, subtracting days used from total days.

methods.name: withinPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setEntitlementTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave entitlement type based on its ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an employee with the entitlement using employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the type of leave using its ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the entitlement period formatted as a string.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the entitlement period formatted as a string.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the credited date of the entitlement formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Checks if the leave entitlement can be deleted based on business rules.
